text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume carrying the weight of the 
"Noble Clan" name, Daiichi Ruby. While 
struggling to achieve good results on 
medium-distance routes, she falls ill with 
an ailment in her legs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Daiichi Ruby's spirit was far 
from broken. Inspired by K.S. Miracle's 
debut race, she resolved to stage her 
comeback in the sprints where her 
aptitudes lay.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
K.S.Miracle puts more passion into her 
training than ever before. She, too, was 
inspired by Daiichi Ruby's presence.
